facts.fact: The Ministry of Public Service and Labour with the Ministry of ICT and Innovation launched a free online AI training programme of four courses for public servants, to be completed by 31 January 2026; no number trained is given.

facts.fact: The notice makes the AI training mandatory for all public servants, including those in education and health institutions, with non-compliance subject to disciplinary measures.
